name: slack
purpose: Chat & messaging via Slack (channels, threads, DMs, search, reactions)
description: Go-based MCP server for Slack workspaces: list/read channels and DMs, fetch unread messages, search history, post and react (posting gated behind an env flag). Uses app-level bot tokens.
install_command: git clone https://github.com/korotovsky/slack-mcp-server.git && cd slack-mcp-server && go run mcp/mcp-server.go --transport stdio
connect_steps: Register <name> in Hermes: config.yaml -> mcp_servers.slack (command + env), or `hermes mcp add slack -- '<command>'`.

Env: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN (bot xoxb-...) and SLACK_APP_TOKEN (app-level xapp-...); create a Slack app with channels:history, channels:read, chat:write scopes; set SLACK_MCP_REACTION_TOOL=1 to enable reactions.
Install Go 1.21+; the binary ships via GitHub releases if you prefer a compiled build.
Restart Hermes, confirm with `hermes mcp list`, then exercise a tool (e.g. a read-only list/search call) to verify.

name: discord
purpose: Discord bot gateway: read/send messages, manage channels and guilds
description: Docker-based MCP server that connects as a Discord bot: list/send messages, manage channels, roles and members via a bot token.
connect_steps: Register <name> in Hermes: config.yaml -> mcp_servers.discord (command + env), or `hermes mcp add discord -- '<command>'`.
Env: DISCORD_TOKEN (bot token from Discord Developer Portal) and optional DISCORD_GUILD_ID; invite the bot to the target server with proper intents.
Requires Docker Desktop running on the Hermes host.
Restart Hermes, confirm with `hermes mcp list`, then exercise a tool (e.g. a read-only list/search call) to verify.

name: teams
purpose: Microsoft Teams: read/send chats and channel messages
description: Official-style npx MCP server for Teams: browse teams/channels, read and send chat + channel messages, with full-scope or --read-only auth.
connect_steps: Register <name> in Hermes: config.yaml -> mcp_servers.teams (command + env), or `hermes mcp add teams -- '<command>'`.
Run `npx @floriscornel/teams-mcp@latest authenticate` once on the host to complete the Microsoft device-login OAuth flow; tokens are cached locally.
Use --read-only for least-privilege setups; `check` shows auth status.
Restart Hermes, confirm with `hermes mcp list`, then exercise a tool (e.g. a read-only list/search call) to verify.

name: gmail
purpose: Gmail: read/send email, manage labels and threads
description: Gmail AutoAuth MCP server: OAuth2 with auto browser launch, read/search/send mail, label and thread management. Credentials persist globally in ~/.gmail-mcp/.
connect_steps: Register <name> in Hermes: config.yaml -> mcp_servers.gmail (command + env), or `hermes mcp add gmail -- '<command>'`.
Place gcp-oauth.keys.json (Google Cloud OAuth client, Gmail API enabled) in ~/.gmail-mcp/; first run opens a browser for consent, then stores credentials.json globally.
Scopes requested: gmail.readonly + gmail.send + labels/modify.
Restart Hermes, confirm with `hermes mcp list`, then exercise a tool (e.g. a read-only list/search call) to verify.

name: outlook
purpose: Outlook/Microsoft 365: mail, calendar, contacts via Graph + Power Automate
description: Node-based MCP server connecting to Microsoft 365 (Outlook mail/calendar, contacts) through the Microsoft Graph API with Azure app registration.
install_command: git clone https://github.com/ryaker/outlook-mcp.git && cd outlook-mcp && npm install && node index.js
connect_steps: Register <name> in Hermes: config.yaml -> mcp_servers.outlook (command + env), or `hermes mcp add outlook -- '<command>'`.
Register an app in Azure Portal (Graph API Mail/Calendars permissions), copy .env.example to .env and fill TENANT_ID / CLIENT_ID / CLIENT_SECRET / user mailbox.
Requires Node 18+ on the host.
Restart Hermes, confirm with `hermes mcp list`, then exercise a tool (e.g. a read-only list/search call) to verify.

name: telegram
purpose: Telegram: send/receive messages, manage chats as a user or bot
description: Python MCP server driving a Telegram user session (or bot): read chats, send messages/media, manage dialogs. Includes session-string generator and Docker option.
install_command: git clone https://github.com/chigwell/telegram-mcp.git && cd telegram-mcp && uv run main.py
connect_steps: Register <name> in Hermes: config.yaml -> mcp_servers.telegram (command + env), or `hermes mcp add telegram -- '<command>'`.
Get TELEGRAM_API_ID + TELEGRAM_API_HASH from my.telegram.org; generate a session with `uv run session_string_generator.py` and export TELEGRAM_SESSION_STRING (or TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN).
Docker alternative: `docker run -d --name telegram-mcp --env-file .env -e MCP_TRANSPORT=http -e MCP_HOST=0.0.0.0 -p 127.0.0.1:8765:8765 telegram-mcp:latest`.
Restart Hermes, confirm with `hermes mcp list`, then exercise a tool (e.g. a read-only list/search call) to verify.
